Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct)
Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation

Required findings: Candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608

Imaging shows any of: degenerative spondylolisthesis without spondylolysis with dynamic segmental instability on flexion‑extension X‑rays or supine‑upright views (>3 mm translation) OR Meyerding Grade II or higher; or spondylolysis with Meyerding I‑II plus progression on plain X‑rays; or Meyerding III+ with ≥50 % anterior slippage or progression; or progressive spinal pain with imaging‑documented progression; or multi‑level spondylolysis; or postoperative facet disruption >50 % bilaterally or >75 % of a single facet; or pars fracture; or iatrogenic spondylolisthesis after prior decompression
Documentation of nicotine‑free status: either never‑smoker or ≥6 weeks abstinence from all nicotine products with objective cotinine test within normal range
Intra‑operative identification of instability waives imaging requirement (see Anticipated Iatrogenic Instability)
Candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608

Planned intra‑operative disruption of posterior elements meeting any of: facet excision >50 % bilaterally or >75 % of a single facet; pars interarticularis removal requiring fusion; decompression for Meyerding Grade I+ spondylolisthesis with foraminal stenosis; partial or complete corpectomy removing ≥1/3 of vertebral body
Documentation of nicotine‑free status as defined above
Candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608

Imaging demonstrates either coronal deformity (Cobb angle >30°, asymmetric disc collapse causing symptomatic foraminal narrowing, or global coronal imbalance with trunk shift) OR sagittal imbalance (sagittal vertical axis >8 cm or pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis mismatch >15°)
Documentation of nicotine‑free status as defined above
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4 > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity

Required findings: Candidate for initial primary lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.2

Advanced imaging shows any of: primary extraforaminal L5‑S1 herniation where far‑lateral approach is not feasible due to iliac wing; primary foraminal herniation requiring facet resection that would cause iatrogenic instability; primary disc herniation at level of conus medullaris
Documentation of nicotine‑free status as defined above
Candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.3 at the same level

Imaging shows anterolisthesis at the level with either dynamic segmental instability on flexion‑extension X‑rays or supine‑upright views (>3 mm translation) OR Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis
Documentation of nicotine‑free status as defined above

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation
Required findings: Candidate for repeat lumbar discectomy per CMM-606.3 at the same level
Documentation of nicotine‑free status as defined above
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.4 > Second or Greater Recurrent Disc Herniation

Non-Indications: Patient is not a candidate for lumbar decompression or corpectomy per CMM-608
Absence of required imaging findings for the specific indication (e.g., no documented dynamic instability, spondylolisthesis grade, or deformity measurements)
Failure to provide documented nicotine‑free status (no never‑smoker declaration and no cotinine test confirming ≥6 weeks abstinence)
Instability not demonstrated on imaging and not identified intra‑operatively for the Actual Instability indication
For Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity, deformity measurements below the specified thresholds (Cobb ≤30°, SVA ≤8 cm, PI‑LL ≤15°)
For Initial Disc Herniation, disc pathology not meeting the listed advanced imaging criteria
Important criteria & exceptions: All indications require the patient to be a candidate for lumbar decompression or corpectomy per CMM-608
Nicotine‑free status must be documented either by never‑smoker status or by objective cotinine testing confirming ≥6 weeks abstinence
For Actual Instability, intra‑operative identification of instability waives the pre‑operative imaging requirement
Imaging must include specific views: flexion‑extension plain X‑rays, supine and upright standing radiographs, and/or MRI/CT as needed to assess spondylolisthesis grade and deformity angles
Concurrent procedures (e.g., facet excision, pars removal, corpectomy) that create anticipated iatrogenic instability automatically meet the instability criterion
Documentation required: CMM-608 lumbar decompression candidacy documentation (clinical notes confirming indication for decompression or corpectomy)
Plain radiographs: flexion‑extension lateral views of the lumbar spine
Supine and upright standing lumbar radiographs for translational measurements
Measurement reports of spondylolisthesis (Meyerding grade) and translational slip (>3 mm) if applicable
Cobb angle measurement report for coronal deformity
Sagittal vertical axis (SVA) measurement and pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis (PI‑LL) mismatch report for sagittal deformity
MRI or CT reports confirming disc herniation location, foraminal stenosis, or conus involvement
Operative reports of prior lumbar decompression if assessing iatrogenic instability
Pathology or radiology report confirming pars fracture or facet disruption
Objective cotinine test results (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range confirming ≥6 weeks nicotine abstinence, or a signed statement of never‑smoker status
